主要内容: On February 17, 2015, Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. filed an 8-K report with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The report included an investor presentation dated February 2015, which the company may use in conversations with investors and analysts. The presentation was also planned to be posted on the company's investor relations website. The filing was under Item 7.01, Regulation FD Disclosure, and it was noted that the information provided would not be deemed 'filed' under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The report was signed by Jeffrey A. Cook, the Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer of the company.
